attributes.name: Lasso
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1d8 to your check to acquire a card that has the Animal trait.

When a character at your location fails a check to defeat a non-villain monster, discard this card; that character evades the monster and puts it on top of the location deck it came from or under its top card.
